messages:
Ravi: quick sync on admission model: we need a path that balances low-latency tokens and fair stateful leases. hybrid router idea: token fastpath for simple requests, lease path for heavy or flagged tenants.

Clara: hybrid sounds right. Need deterministic routing rule set: threshold by burn-rate and per-minute token loss. Also explicit hint to downstream: admit_mode.

Marta: concerns: leases require local cache + renewals. If central lease service is slow, fallback must be safe. Fallback policy: tokens with a temporary penalty multiplier.

Ravi: agreed. Add telemetry fields: admit_mode, admit_id, fallback_reason, lease_ttl_ms. Alert if fallback_rate > 0.5% for 10m.

Clara: API minimal: POST /admit {client_id, hints} -> {admit:true|false, mode:token|lease, id:abc}. Keep schema tiny.

Marta: rollout: spike (1wk) -> prototype on staging (2wk) -> canary 5% prod -> 25% -> 100%. Add chaos tests: central down, lease tombstones, clock skew.

Ravi: owners: eng-platform Ravi+Clara, eng-sre Marta. I'll draft follow-up RFC and runbook. eng-bot: create meeting?

eng-bot: meeting created Thu 9am PT "Admission hybrid scrub". Reminder 24h.
